beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus sat on a green hillside above the Sea of Galilee, an ordinary crowd gathered on the grass around him — fishermen, mothers, farmers, children. And to these plain, unremarkable people he said something astonishing about who they were. He began with salt.

timing.text: Jesus sat on a green hillside above the Sea of Galilee, an ordinary crowd gathered on the grass around him — fishermen, mothers, farmers, children.
And to these plain, unremarkable people he said something astonishing about who they were.
He began with salt.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

timing.text: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted?
it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: In that world salt was precious. It kept food from spoiling and it made plain things taste good. That, he told them, is what you are — you keep the world from going bad, and you bring out the good in it. You matter that much.

timing.text: In that world salt was precious.
It kept food from spoiling and it made plain things taste good.
That, he told them, is what you are — you keep the world from going bad, and you bring out the good in it.
You matter that much.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But salt has one job, and if it goes flat and loses its flavour it is no use to anyone — it just gets swept out and walked over. He was not threatening them; he was telling them not to waste what they were. Stay salty. Stay yourselves.

timing.text: But salt has one job, and if it goes flat and loses its flavour it is no use to anyone — it just gets swept out and walked over.
He was not threatening them; he was telling them not to waste what they were.
Stay salty.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

timing.text: Ye are the light of the world.
A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then he pointed them to light. A town built up on a hilltop, its lamps lit at dusk, can be seen for miles — there is no hiding it. That, he said, is you: not something the world should have to squint to find, but a light set up where everyone can see.

timing.text: Then he pointed them to light.
A town built up on a hilltop, its lamps lit at dusk, can be seen for miles — there is no hiding it.
That, he said, is you: not something the world should have to squint to find, but a light set up where everyone can see.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

timing.text: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Nobody lights a lamp and then hides it under a basket. That would be pointless — smothering the very thing they lit it for.

timing.text: Nobody lights a lamp and then hides it under a basket.
That would be pointless — smothering the very thing they lit it for.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You set it up high, on a stand, so its light reaches into every corner and everyone in the house can see. Your goodness was never meant to be hidden away. It was meant to give light to the people around you.

timing.text: You set it up high, on a stand, so its light reaches into every corner and everyone in the house can see.
Your goodness was never meant to be hidden away.
It was meant to give light to the people around you.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

timing.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Live openly good — kind, honest, generous — right out where people can see it.

timing.text: Live openly good — kind, honest, generous — right out where people can see it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But notice the reason. Not so they will admire you. So that when they see the good you do, their eyes will lift past you to God, and they will love him for it. Your light is not about you at all. It points home to your Father.

timing.text: But notice the reason.
Not so they will admire you.
So that when they see the good you do, their eyes will lift past you to God, and they will love him for it.
Your light is not about you at all.
It points home to your Father.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is the whole charge, and it is a gentle one. You do not have to become something you are not. You already are salt; you already are light. Just don't lose your savour, and don't hide your lamp. Go out, stay bright, and be exactly what the world needs.

card.text: You are the salt of the earth. You are the light of the world. Not someday, if you are good enough — right now, as you are. Where could your light give someone else a little more of God today?
